label: Bible Study
prompt: The beauty of Israel is slain upon thy high places: how are the _____ fallen!
verse: The beauty of Israel is slain upon thy high places: how are the mighty fallen!
note: David's lament for Saul and Jonathan — 'how are the mighty fallen' repeats three times in the song.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: They shall not _____ nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them: for he that hath mercy on them shall lead them, even by the springs of water shall he guide them.
verse: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them: for he that hath mercy on them shall lead them, even by the springs of water shall he guide them.
note: No hunger, no thirst, no scorching sun — God leads His people by springs of water.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he sent, and brought him in. Now he was _____, and withal of a beautiful countenance, and goodly to look to. And the LORD said, Arise, anoint him: for this is he.
verse: And he sent, and brought him in. Now he was ruddy, and withal of a beautiful countenance, and goodly to look to. And the LORD said, Arise, anoint him: for this is he.
note: The youngest son, called in from the sheep: ruddy, with a beautiful countenance — and God said, 'This is he.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: And of some have _____, making a difference:
verse: And of some have compassion, making a difference:
note: Jude's fiery letter softens here: for the wavering, compassion first — care can make the difference.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And while he _____, the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters; the LORD being merciful unto him: and they brought him forth, and set him without the city.
verse: And while he lingered, the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters; the LORD being merciful unto him: and they brought him forth, and set him without the city.
note: Even with judgment at the door, Lot 'lingered' — so the angels took him by the hand, 'the LORD being merciful unto him.'
